<thought>We need to find retrosynthetic templates for three disconnections: (1) amide bond formation between the aromatic amide and aniline; (2) sulfonamide formation between an aniline and sulfonyl chloride; (3) Doebner modification to form the α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid side chain. We'll search the template catalog for each transformation and then construct the route JSON using the returned template IDs.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
